snippet.title: Grems - Official Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4000720/Grems/

*Game Type*
Grems is a cozy 2D exploration game that blends hand-drawn aliens, photography, scrapbooking, and friendship building elements. 

*Story and Gameplay*
Bipp is a new arrival on Roqo, a strange planet full of even stranger creatures called Grems. Bipp wants to meet everyone, but isn’t much of a talker. Instead of speaking, she takes pictures and shares them with others to gather their reactions. When a Grem gets a photo they like, they give her clothing, decorations, and other souvenirs. Along the way, Bipp fills a scrapbook with photos, quotes, and stickers to bring home to her family.

Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie
Developer: Grem Games
Publisher: Grem Games
Release Date: To be announced
